_description: Research-based optimizations for Augment extension performance
_tokenRefreshInterval_comment: Refresh every hour instead of 9 seconds (99.75% reduction)
_preemptiveRefresh_comment: Disable preemptive refresh to reduce keyring access
_retryOnFailure_comment: Disable auth retry storms that cause cascading failures
_networkTimeout_comment: Increase timeout from 30s to 60s for AI processing latency
_retryAttempts_comment: Reduce retries from 3 to 2 to prevent retry storms
_retryDelay_comment: 5 second delay between retries to prevent server overload
_keepAlive_comment: Enable connection reuse to reduce connection overhead
_cacheEnabled_comment: Enable caching to reduce redundant API calls
_cacheMaxSize_comment: Reasonable cache size for performance without excessive memory usage
_cacheTtl_comment: 1 hour cache TTL to balance freshness and performance
_cacheCompression_comment: Enable compression to maximize cache efficiency
_maxConcurrentRequests_comment: Limit concurrent requests to prevent resource contention
_requestThrottling_comment: Enable throttling to prevent API rate limit issues
_backgroundProcessing_comment: Disable background processing to reduce resource usage
_loggingLevel_comment: Reduce logging verbosity to decrease I/O overhead
_loggingMaxFileSize_comment: Limit log file size to prevent disk space issues
_loggingEnableDebug_comment: Disable debug logging for production use
_uiAnimationsEnabled_comment: Disable animations to reduce CPU usage and improve responsiveness
_uiPreloadContent_comment: Disable preloading to reduce memory usage
_uiLazyLoading_comment: Enable lazy loading to improve startup performance
_memoryGarbageCollection_comment: Aggressive GC to prevent memory leaks
_memoryMaxHeapSize_comment: Reasonable heap limit to prevent excessive memory usage
_telemetryEnabled_comment: Disable telemetry for privacy and performance
_analyticsEnabled_comment: Disable analytics to reduce network traffic
_updatesAutoCheck_comment: Disable automatic update checks to reduce background activity
